scope: overtaking (passing another vehicle, and being passed)

vocabulary.definition: Moving past the vehicle ahead; overtaking.
A person driving a motor vehicle on the road.
A stretch of road where passing is prohibited, marked by a solid yellow line on the driver's side of the center line or by a 'No Passing Zone' pennant or 'Do Not Pass' sign.
A broken or dashed painted line on the road.
A continuous yellow painted line on the road.
Two parallel continuous yellow painted lines on the road.
An area around a vehicle that its driver cannot see in the rearview mirrors.
A center lane shared by traffic in both directions that is used only by vehicles turning left.
A highway where vehicles can enter and exit only at interchanges.
The width between the boundary lines of a publicly maintained way any part of which is open to the public for vehicular travel.
A motor vehicle, other than a tractor, equipped with a rider's saddle and designed to have not more than three wheels on the ground when propelled.
A large truck or truck-tractor combination (tractor-trailer).
A freeway, toll-road, throughway, turnpike or expressway.

An emergency medical vehicle, law enforcement vehicle, fire truck, tow truck, utility service vehicle, Texas Department of Transportation (TxDOT) vehicle, or other highway construction or maintenance vehicle.

rules.title: Wait until it is safe to pass
rules.when: it is not safe to pass
rules.action: be patient and wait until the time is right before passing
rules.statement: WHEN it is not safe to pass, the DRIVER MUST be patient and wait until the time is right before passing.
rules.note: Reason given: improper passing often results in deadly head-on crashes.

rules.title: Make certain the way is clear
rules.when: about to pass
rules.action: make certain the way is clear
rules.statement: WHEN about to pass, the PASSER MUST make certain the way is clear.

vague_terms.explanation: no gap or sight distance given

rules.title: Signal before changing lanes to pass
rules.when: changing lanes to pass
rules.action: give the proper signal before changing lanes
rules.statement: WHEN changing lanes to pass, the PASSER MUST give the proper signal before changing lanes.

rules.title: Tap horn when necessary
rules.when: passing AND it is necessary to avoid surprising or to alert the DRIVER ahead
rules.action: tap the horn
rules.statement: WHEN passing AND it is necessary to avoid surprising or to alert the DRIVER ahead, the PASSER MUST tap the horn.

vague_terms.explanation: does not say when a horn tap is needed

rules.note: Stated in both the basic safety rules and the two-lane passing procedure.

rules.title: Avoid cutting in too quickly
rules.when: returning to the original lane after a PASS
rules.action: cut in too quickly
rules.statement: WHEN returning to the original lane after a PASS, the PASSER SHOULD NOT cut in too quickly.

rules.title: Do not linger in the other driver's blind spot
rules.when: passing another vehicle
rules.action: either complete the PASS or slow down out of the other DRIVER's BLIND SPOT, and not drive or linger in it
rules.statement: WHEN passing another vehicle, the PASSER MUST either complete the PASS or slow down out of the other DRIVER's BLIND SPOT, and not drive or linger in it.
rules.note: Diagram shows blind spots to the rear on both sides of a car. Reason: the other driver likely cannot see you in or near the blind spot. Stated again under Highway Safety Tips (10.48).

rules.title: Keep right except to pass
rules.when: driving on a road
rules.action: keep to the right side of the road
rules.unless: passing another vehicle on a two- or three-lane street OR driving on a one-way street OR the right side of the road is blocked
rules.statement: WHEN driving on a road, the DRIVER MUST keep to the right side of the road, UNLESS passing another vehicle on a two- or three-lane street OR driving on a one-way street OR the right side of the road is blocked.
rules.note: Worded 'Always keep to the right side of the road except when…'. LOC-01 to LOC-04, MARK-02 and SIGN-01 limit when the left side of the road may be used to pass.

rules.title: Left lane for passing only
rules.when: on a roadway with more than one lane in the same direction AND a 'Left Lane for Passing Only' sign is posted
rules.action: travel in the farthest left lane
rules.statement: WHEN on a roadway with more than one lane in the same direction AND a 'Left Lane for Passing Only' sign is posted, the DRIVER MUST NOT travel in the farthest left lane, UNLESS passing.
rules.note: Regulatory sign; drivers must obey regulatory signs (6.115). The sign description itself uses 'slower traffic should travel in a lane other than the farthest left lane'.

rules.title: Use middle or left lane on highway to pass
rules.when: passing other vehicles on a multi-lane FREEWAY
rules.action: use the middle or left lane
rules.statement: WHEN passing other vehicles on a multi-lane FREEWAY, the PASSER MUST use the middle or left lane.
rules.note: PASS-SIDE-01 permits passing on the right on multi-lane roads (7.42–7.43); the handbook does not say which applies on a FREEWAY.

rules.title: Keep distance to see ahead
rules.when: preparing to pass on a two-lane road
rules.action: keep enough distance from the car in front to see ahead clearly
rules.statement: WHEN preparing to pass on a two-lane road, the PASSER MUST keep enough distance from the car in front to see ahead clearly.

rules.title: Check mirrors and blind spot before passing
rules.when: preparing to pass on a two-lane road
rules.action: check the rearview mirror and side mirrors and look over the shoulder into the BLIND SPOT to make sure the roadway is clear and no other vehicles are passing the PASSER
rules.statement: WHEN preparing to pass on a two-lane road, the PASSER MUST check the rearview mirror and side mirrors and look over the shoulder into the BLIND SPOT to make sure the roadway is clear and no other vehicles are passing the PASSER.

rules.title: Left turn signal before passing
rules.when: preparing to pass on a two-lane road
rules.action: turn on the left turn signal to alert DRIVERS behind
rules.statement: WHEN preparing to pass on a two-lane road, the PASSER MUST turn on the left turn signal to alert DRIVERS behind.

rules.title: Check ahead for no-passing zones and oncoming traffic
rules.when: preparing to pass on a two-lane road
rules.action: check well ahead for signs and pavement markings of a NO-PASSING ZONE and check for oncoming traffic in the left lane
rules.statement: WHEN preparing to pass on a two-lane road, the PASSER MUST check well ahead for signs and pavement markings of a NO-PASSING ZONE and check for oncoming traffic in the left lane.

rules.title: Return before oncoming car is within 200 feet
rules.when: passing on a two-lane road
rules.action: be sure there is enough time and space to overtake the car ahead and return to the right lane before an approaching car comes within 200 feet
rules.statement: WHEN passing on a two-lane road, the PASSER MUST be sure there is enough time and space to overtake the car ahead and return to the right lane before an approaching car comes within 200 feet.

rules.title: Pass on the left and clear before returning
rules.when: passing on a two-lane road
rules.action: pass on the left and not return to the right lane until the overtaken vehicle is safely cleared and visible in the rearview mirror
rules.statement: WHEN passing on a two-lane road, the PASSER MUST pass on the left and not return to the right lane until the overtaken vehicle is safely cleared and visible in the rearview mirror.

vague_terms.explanation: defined only by the rearview-mirror check

rules.note: Diagram shows the passing car moving into the left lane and back to the right lane ahead of the overtaken car.

rules.title: Signal right to return and cancel signal
rules.when: the PASSER has overtaken the vehicle being passed on a two-lane road
rules.action: turn on the right turn signal, return to the right lane, and turn the signal off after the lane change is completed
rules.statement: WHEN the PASSER has overtaken the vehicle being passed on a two-lane road, the PASSER MUST turn on the right turn signal, return to the right lane, and turn the signal off after the lane change is completed.

rules.title: No left side on roads with two or more lanes each way
rules.when: there are two or more traffic lanes in each direction
rules.action: drive on the left side of the road
rules.statement: WHEN there are two or more traffic lanes in each direction, the DRIVER MUST NOT drive on the left side of the road.
rules.note: Worded 'Never drive on the left side of the road when...'.

rules.title: Not near intersections or railroad crossings
rules.when: within 100 feet of or crossing an intersection or railroad crossing
rules.action: drive on the left side of the road
rules.statement: WHEN within 100 feet of or crossing an intersection or railroad crossing, the DRIVER MUST NOT drive on the left side of the road.

rules.title: Not on hills, curves or where vision is limited
rules.when: on a hill, curve, or any other place where vision is limited
rules.action: drive on the left side of the road
rules.statement: WHEN on a hill, curve, or any other place where vision is limited, the DRIVER MUST NOT drive on the left side of the road.

rules.title: Not near bridges, viaducts or tunnels
rules.when: within 100 feet of a bridge, viaduct, or tunnel
rules.action: drive on the left side of the road
rules.statement: WHEN within 100 feet of a bridge, viaduct, or tunnel, the DRIVER MUST NOT drive on the left side of the road.

rules.title: Never pass in the center left-turn lane
rules.when: on a road with a CENTER LEFT-TURN LANE
rules.action: use the CENTER LEFT-TURN LANE for passing or as a through-traffic lane
rules.statement: WHEN on a road with a CENTER LEFT-TURN LANE, the DRIVER MUST NOT use the CENTER LEFT-TURN LANE for passing or as a through-traffic lane.
rules.note: Text words this as 'should never be used'; recorded as REQUIREMENT because it is shown on a regulatory 'Center Lane Only' sign and stated twice.

rules.title: Broken line: passing allowed if safe
rules.when: the line the PASSER would cross to pass another vehicle is a BROKEN LINE AND it is safe
rules.action: cross it
rules.statement: WHEN the line the PASSER would cross to pass another vehicle is a BROKEN LINE AND it is safe, the PASSER MAY cross it.
rules.note: On a two-lane rural road the broken yellow center line may also be crossed when the right half of the road is closed.

rules.title: Do not cross solid yellow line or when unsafe
rules.when: on a two-lane road with two-way traffic AND either the center line on the DRIVER's side is a SOLID YELLOW LINE or crossing it is not safe
rules.action: cross the center line to pass
rules.statement: WHEN on a two-lane road with two-way traffic AND either the center line on the DRIVER's side is a SOLID YELLOW LINE or crossing it is not safe, the DRIVER MUST NOT cross the center line to pass.
rules.note: A SOLID YELLOW LINE on the driver's side marks a NO-PASSING ZONE (6.200); the diagram shows a car crossing only where its side is broken.

rules.title: Do not cross double yellow line to pass
rules.when: on a multi-lane HIGHWAY with a DOUBLE YELLOW LINE
rules.action: cross the DOUBLE YELLOW LINE to pass
rules.statement: WHEN on a multi-lane HIGHWAY with a DOUBLE YELLOW LINE, the DRIVER MUST NOT cross the DOUBLE YELLOW LINE to pass.

rules.title: No Passing Zone and Do Not Pass signs
rules.when: a 'No Passing Zone' pennant sign or a 'Do Not Pass' sign applies to the DRIVER's direction
rules.action: pass other vehicles
rules.statement: WHEN a 'No Passing Zone' pennant sign or a 'Do Not Pass' sign applies to the DRIVER's direction, the DRIVER MUST NOT pass other vehicles.
rules.note: The pennant shape is used for advance warning of no-pass zones; reason given: sight distance ahead is too limited for safe passing. The pennant is a warning sign; disobeying it is a violation with a fine of $1 to $200 (6.266, 6.267).

rules.title: Curve and winding road signs: do not pass
rules.when: passing a warning sign for a reverse curve, sharp turn, gradual curve, reverse sharp turn, sharp curve chevron, or winding road
rules.action: pass other vehicles in the curve or winding section ahead
rules.statement: WHEN passing a warning sign for a reverse curve, sharp turn, gradual curve, reverse sharp turn, sharp curve chevron, or winding road, the DRIVER MUST NOT pass other vehicles in the curve or winding section ahead.
rules.penalty: A fine of $1 to $200, doubled in a work zone with workers present.
rules.note: Disobeying a warning sign is a violation (6.56, 6.266), punishable by the fine in 6.267. Each sign description also says to slow down and keep right; those are not passing rules.

rules.title: Two-arrow sign: pass on either side
rules.when: a sign shows two arrows pointing down to the left and right at a traffic island or obstruction
rules.action: pass on either side of it
rules.statement: WHEN a sign shows two arrows pointing down to the left and right at a traffic island or obstruction, the DRIVER MAY pass on either side of it.
rules.note: The sign is a yellow diamond with two arrows pointing down and outward (6.98-f1).

rules.title: Barricade stripes: bear to the side they slope down
rules.when: a barricade or vertical panel has diagonal stripes sloping downward to one side
rules.action: bear to the side to which the stripes slope downward
rules.statement: WHEN a barricade or vertical panel has diagonal stripes sloping downward to one side, the DRIVER SHOULD bear to the side to which the stripes slope downward.
rules.note: Stripes sloping downward to the right mean bear right (6.245, figure 6.246); to the left, bear left (6.248, figure 6.249).

rules.title: When passing on the right is allowed
rules.when: conditions permit doing so safely AND the road is one-way or is both clear of parked vehicles and other lane obstructions and wide enough for two or more lanes in each direction
rules.action: pass on the right
rules.statement: WHEN conditions permit doing so safely AND the road is one-way or is both clear of parked vehicles and other lane obstructions and wide enough for two or more lanes in each direction, the PASSER MAY ONLY pass on the right.
rules.note: Passing on a paved shoulder is a separate permission (PASS-SIDE-02). MAY ONLY means passing on the right is allowed only in these conditions; it does not forbid passing on the left. On a multi-lane FREEWAY, PASS-GEN-09 tells the PASSER to use the middle or left lane (10.23).

rules.title: Passing on a paved shoulder
rules.when: conditions permit doing so safely AND the vehicle being passed is slowing or stopped on the main traveled portion of the HIGHWAY, disabled, or preparing to make a left turn
rules.action: pass on a paved shoulder
rules.statement: WHEN conditions permit doing so safely AND the vehicle being passed is slowing or stopped on the main traveled portion of the HIGHWAY, disabled, or preparing to make a left turn, the PASSER MAY ONLY pass on a paved shoulder.
rules.note: MAY ONLY: 7.42 allows passing on the right only when conditions permit it safely, and the paved shoulder is one of its listed cases; it does not require using the shoulder.

rules.title: Do not pass on the right off the pavement
rules.when: passing on the right
rules.action: drive off the paved portion of the HIGHWAY
rules.statement: WHEN passing on the right, the PASSER MUST NOT drive off the paved portion of the HIGHWAY.

rules.title: Stop for a school bus with flashing red lights
rules.when: approaching a school bus from either direction AND the bus is displaying alternately flashing red lights
rules.action: stop
rules.unless: the school bus is on a different road OR the DRIVER is on a CONTROLLED-ACCESS HIGHWAY where the bus is stopped in a loading zone and pedestrians are not permitted to cross
rules.statement: WHEN approaching a school bus from either direction AND the bus is displaying alternately flashing red lights, the DRIVER MUST stop, UNLESS the school bus is on a different road OR the DRIVER is on a CONTROLLED-ACCESS HIGHWAY where the bus is stopped in a loading zone and pedestrians are not permitted to cross.
rules.penalty: 1st conviction $500-$1,250; 2nd within 5 years $1,000-$2,000 and possible suspension up to six months; causing serious bodily injury is a Class A misdemeanor or state jail felony; subsequent conviction causes automatic suspension.
rules.note: Diagram shows traffic in both directions stopped for a school bus with flashing lights while pedestrians walk beside the bus. Text says penalties are in 'Table 17' but they appear in Table 15.

rules.title: Do not pass a stopped school bus until allowed
rules.when: the DRIVER has stopped for a school bus displaying alternately flashing red lights
rules.action: pass the school bus
rules.unless: the school bus has resumed motion OR the DRIVER of the school bus signals the DRIVER to proceed OR the red lights are no longer flashing
rules.statement: WHEN the DRIVER has stopped for a school bus displaying alternately flashing red lights, the DRIVER MUST NOT pass the school bus, UNLESS the school bus has resumed motion OR the DRIVER of the school bus signals the DRIVER to proceed OR the red lights are no longer flashing.
rules.penalty: 1st conviction $500-$1,250; 2nd within 5 years $1,000-$2,000 and possible suspension up to six months; causing serious bodily injury is a Class A misdemeanor or state jail felony; subsequent conviction causes automatic suspension.
rules.note: 5.78's exceptions are in USER-01: a DRIVER who need not stop is not in this rule's condition.

rules.title: Mail, delivery and trash vehicles
rules.when: approaching a mail, delivery, or trash-collection vehicle stopped in the roadway
rules.action: proceed with caution and, if possible, change lanes before safely passing the vehicle
rules.statement: WHEN approaching a mail, delivery, or trash-collection vehicle stopped in the roadway, the DRIVER MUST proceed with caution and, if possible, change lanes before safely passing the vehicle.

vague_terms.explanation: does not say when a lane change is impossible

rules.title: Checks before passing a truck
rules.when: about to pass a TRUCK
rules.action: move into the passing lane before checking front and rear, mirrors and BLIND SPOTS, and confirming the lane is clear and the road is a legal passing zone
rules.statement: WHEN about to pass a TRUCK, the PASSER MUST NOT move into the passing lane before checking front and rear, mirrors and BLIND SPOTS, and confirming the lane is clear and the road is a legal passing zone.

rules.title: Flash headlights when passing a truck
rules.when: passing a TRUCK
rules.action: let the DRIVER of the TRUCK know of the PASS by flashing the headlights
rules.statement: WHEN passing a TRUCK, the PASSER MUST let the DRIVER of the TRUCK know of the PASS by flashing the headlights.
rules.note: The handbook adds "especially at night".

rules.title: Complete the pass quickly
rules.when: passing a TRUCK or other vehicle
rules.action: complete the PASS as quickly as possible and not stay alongside the other vehicle
rules.statement: WHEN passing a TRUCK or other vehicle, the PASSER MUST complete the PASS as quickly as possible and not stay alongside the other vehicle.
rules.note: Context: passing a truck on a level road takes 3 to 5 seconds longer than a car; on a downgrade the PASSER may need to increase speed.

rules.title: Return in front of a truck only when its front is visible
rules.when: returning in front of a TRUCK after passing it
rules.action: move back into the lane
rules.unless: the entire front of the TRUCK can be seen in the rearview mirror
rules.statement: WHEN returning in front of a TRUCK after passing it, the PASSER MUST NOT move back into the lane, UNLESS the entire front of the TRUCK can be seen in the rearview mirror.
rules.note: The truck driver flashing the truck's lights after the pass signals that it is clear to pull back in.

rules.title: Maintain speed after passing a truck
rules.when: having passed a TRUCK
rules.action: maintain speed
rules.statement: WHEN having passed a TRUCK, the PASSER MUST maintain speed.

rules.title: Never cut in front of a truck
rules.when: trying to reach an exit or turn, or a single-lane construction zone, ahead of a TRUCK or bus
rules.action: slow down and exit or stay behind the TRUCK or bus, and not cut into the open space in front of it
rules.statement: WHEN trying to reach an exit or turn, or a single-lane construction zone, ahead of a TRUCK or bus, the DRIVER MUST slow down and exit or stay behind the TRUCK or bus, and not cut into the open space in front of it.
rules.note: Reason: cutting in removes the driver's cushion of safety.

rules.title: Do not pass a truck on the right that may turn right
rules.when: there is a possibility a TRUCK ahead might make a right turn
rules.action: pass the TRUCK on the right
rules.statement: WHEN there is a possibility a TRUCK ahead might make a right turn, the DRIVER MUST NOT pass the TRUCK on the right.

vague_terms.explanation: no cues given beyond paying attention to turn signals

rules.note: Trucks make wide right turns and may leave an open space on the right before turning.

rules.title: Wait for a backing truck
rules.when: a TRUCK is preparing to back or is backing from the road into a loading area
rules.action: wait for the TRUCK to complete its maneuver before trying to pass, and never cross behind it
rules.statement: WHEN a TRUCK is preparing to back or is backing from the road into a loading area, the DRIVER MUST wait for the TRUCK to complete its maneuver before trying to pass, and never cross behind it.

rules.title: Care when passing a distracted driver
rules.when: passing the vehicle of a DRIVER who seems to be distracted
rules.action: be very careful
rules.statement: WHEN passing the vehicle of a DRIVER who seems to be distracted, the PASSER SHOULD be very careful.

vague_terms.explanation: cues listed in 10.207-10.210 but judgement left to driver

rules.note: Reason given: the other driver may not be aware of the PASSER and may drift in front (10.212).

rules.title: Do not share a lane with a motorcycle
rules.when: near a MOTORCYCLE in a traffic lane
rules.action: allow the MOTORCYCLE a full lane width, and not attempt to share the lane with it
rules.statement: WHEN near a MOTORCYCLE in a traffic lane, the DRIVER MUST allow the MOTORCYCLE a full lane width, and not attempt to share the lane with it.
rules.note: Included because it rules out passing a motorcycle within its lane.

rules.title: Cyclist may leave the right edge to overtake
rules.when: overtaking and passing another vehicle proceeding in the same direction
rules.action: ride away from the right curb or edge of the road and take the full lane
rules.statement: WHEN overtaking and passing another vehicle proceeding in the same direction, the CYCLIST MAY ride away from the right curb or edge of the road and take the full lane.
rules.note: Exception to the rule that a slower cyclist rides as near as possible to the right edge.

rules.title: Move over or slow down for a stopped service vehicle
rules.when: the road has two or more lanes in the DRIVER's direction AND the DRIVER is approaching a SERVICE VEHICLE stopped on the road with its lights on or flashing
rules.action: move out of the lane closest to the SERVICE VEHICLE, or reduce speed to 20 mph below the speed limit or, where the posted speed limit is less than 25 mph, to less than 5 mph
rules.unless: a law enforcement officer directs otherwise
rules.statement: WHEN the road has two or more lanes in the DRIVER's direction AND the DRIVER is approaching a SERVICE VEHICLE stopped on the road with its lights on or flashing, the DRIVER MUST move out of the lane closest to the SERVICE VEHICLE, or reduce speed to 20 mph below the speed limit or, where the posted speed limit is less than 25 mph, to less than 5 mph, UNLESS a law enforcement officer directs otherwise.
rules.note: 9.29–9.31 and 5.68–5.71 state the duty as a choice ('or'). 9.29 lists the vehicles; 5.68 names only a stopped emergency vehicle and gives the exception for an officer's direction; 5.71 gives the under-25-mph case.

rules.title: Slow down for a stopped service vehicle on a one-lane road
rules.when: the road has one lane in the DRIVER's direction AND the DRIVER is approaching a SERVICE VEHICLE stopped on the road with its lights on or flashing
rules.action: reduce speed to 20 mph below the speed limit or, where the posted speed limit is less than 25 mph, to less than 5 mph
rules.unless: a law enforcement officer directs otherwise
rules.statement: WHEN the road has one lane in the DRIVER's direction AND the DRIVER is approaching a SERVICE VEHICLE stopped on the road with its lights on or flashing, the DRIVER MUST reduce speed to 20 mph below the speed limit or, where the posted speed limit is less than 25 mph, to less than 5 mph, UNLESS a law enforcement officer directs otherwise.
rules.note: 9.29–9.31 and 5.68–5.71 state the duty as a choice ('or'). 9.29 lists the vehicles; 5.68 names only a stopped emergency vehicle and gives the exception for an officer's direction; 5.71 gives the under-25-mph case. With one lane in the DRIVER's direction, slowing is the only choice.

rules.title: Do not speed up when being passed
rules.when: another vehicle is passing the DRIVER's vehicle
rules.action: increase speed
rules.statement: WHEN another vehicle is passing the DRIVER's vehicle, the DRIVER MUST NOT increase speed.
rules.note: Stated in general and again for trucks.

rules.title: Stay in lane when being passed
rules.when: another vehicle is passing the DRIVER's vehicle
rules.action: stay in the DRIVER's lane
rules.statement: WHEN another vehicle is passing the DRIVER's vehicle, the DRIVER MUST stay in the DRIVER's lane.

rules.title: Move right on unmarked roads when being passed
rules.when: being passed on the left AND the lanes are not marked
rules.action: safely move as far to the right as possible
rules.statement: WHEN being passed on the left AND the lanes are not marked, the DRIVER MUST safely move as far to the right as possible.

vague_terms.term: as far to the right as possible

rules.title: Make passing easy for the other driver
rules.when: another vehicle is passing the DRIVER's vehicle
rules.action: make it as safe and easy as possible for the PASSER to pass
rules.statement: WHEN another vehicle is passing the DRIVER's vehicle, the DRIVER MUST make it as safe and easy as possible for the PASSER to pass.

vague_terms.term: as safe and easy as possible

rules.title: Keep to far side of lane when a truck passes
rules.when: a TRUCK is passing the DRIVER
rules.action: keep to the far side of the DRIVER's lane
rules.statement: WHEN a TRUCK is passing the DRIVER, the DRIVER MUST keep to the far side of the DRIVER's lane.

rules.title: Slightly reduce speed when a truck passes
rules.when: a TRUCK is passing the DRIVER
rules.action: slightly reduce speed
rules.statement: WHEN a TRUCK is passing the DRIVER, the DRIVER SHOULD slightly reduce speed.
rules.note: Worded 'You'll make it easier for the truck driver if...'.

rules.title: Truck driver helps the passer
rules.when: being passed by another vehicle
rules.action: stay to the far side of the lane
rules.statement: WHEN being passed by another vehicle, the DRIVER of a TRUCK SHOULD stay to the far side of the lane.
rules.note: The truck driver's signal when returning after passing is BEING-10.

rules.title: Do not block someone from passing
rules.when: another DRIVER is trying to pass or enter the DRIVER's lane
rules.action: intentionally slow down, slam on the brakes, or speed up to keep that DRIVER from passing or entering
rules.statement: WHEN another DRIVER is trying to pass or enter the DRIVER's lane, the DRIVER MUST NOT intentionally slow down, slam on the brakes, or speed up to keep that DRIVER from passing or entering.
rules.note: Given as a tip to avoid road rage.

rules.title: Be prepared to move over for faster traffic
rules.when: driving on a FREEWAY in any lane except the right lane used for slower traffic
rules.action: be prepared to move to another lane to allow faster traffic to pass
rules.statement: WHEN driving on a FREEWAY in any lane except the right lane used for slower traffic, the DRIVER SHOULD be prepared to move to another lane to allow faster traffic to pass.

rules.title: Truck signals before returning after a pass
rules.when: the DRIVER of a TRUCK has passed another vehicle AND is returning to that vehicle's lane
rules.action: signal
rules.statement: WHEN the DRIVER of a TRUCK has passed another vehicle AND is returning to that vehicle's lane, the DRIVER of the TRUCK SHOULD signal.
rules.note: Given so the driver of the passed vehicle knows the TRUCK is returning to the lane.
